Name: Cuter Maru Sprite
Author: Peasant00
Description:
This mod makes Maru's sprite look cuter as well as the nurse Maru Sprite
The Mod goes with [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/cute-portraits-v1-2-maru-updated.107756/]vstoto's portraid mod[/url]

I didn't make this mod, I just made it compatible with Content Patcher
The author is [b]canddleit[/b], here's their [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/cuter-maru-sprite.145058/]original files
[/url]
[b]Installing the Mod
[/b]First download the zip file and extract it
after extracting the file, move the folder named [CP] Cute Maru into the stardew valley mods folder
